notes.title: Now live: Necrology, an easier way to access the beta and bugfixes
notes.content: [h2]Necrology (currently in the beta only!)[/h2][p]We've added a necrology to the game![/p][p]This lists all your fallen soldiers, along with the cause of their deaths. Deaths are easy to miss sometimes, and as a new player their cause might not be fully understood, so this should help you figure out why a soldier might have fallen and how to avoid it next time.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4be781df7a1466b872355bf542440f1ce8b278c6.png"][/img][/h2][h2]An easier way to switch between branches[/h2][p]You can now easily switch to the beta branch (and back to the default one, if you like) right from the main menu![/p][p]Keep in mind that this option only shows up if you have the game's language set to English.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a575c9d55610266b8ada15b416f6829fc53ea20.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Full patch notes:[/h2][h3]Main Game Version 1.0.0.2[/h3][list][*][p]Added a button to switch between beta and stable builds in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the “Accept all the different opportunity types” achievement being ungettable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the promoted version of Margrave Mizla and his successor giving less power than specified.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Borbak, long-neck liaison activating with Robert Horka’s arrow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mercer Tarcha occasionally not giving armor to adjacent cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the behaviour of Ibran, eager scout.[/p][/*][*][p]Translation improvements for Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Beta Version 1.0.1.1e[/h3][p]You can now switch to this version from the main menu! Alternatively, right click the game in Steam and go to Properties > Betas.[/p][list][*][p]All fixes and changes from Version 1.0.0.2[/p][/*][*][p]Added Necrology, a list of all card deaths with their causes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hugo dying after winning a battle if the card was previously a Papery Infantry.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Save The Kingdoms Quiz Competition!
notes.content: [h3]Hello, beloved subjects![/h3][p][/p][p]We do hope fortune has been favouring the best tacticians and strategists this realm has ever seen![/p][p][/p][p]The people of our allied kingdom, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/"]Dicealot[/url], have today announced the date that they shall be open to the world! October 9th will be the day that people from all over may finally experience all that [b]Dicealot[/b] has to offer. We trust that our subjects would show them the same love and generosity that you have showed us![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]To celebrate,[/h3][p]We're running a quiz competition! Half the questions are based on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333700/The_Royal_Writ/"]The Royal Writ[/url], and half the questions are about fellow medieval roguelike [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035330/Dicealot/"]Dicealot[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Every correct answer = 1 chance to win.[/b] That means you'll have a chance to win even if you're only familiar with [b]The Royal Writ[/b], but the odds are higher if you also know [b]Dicealot[/b]! All answers can be found in the demos for both games. [/p][p][/p][h3]Take the quiz [url="https://forms.gle/juiMsSYnc4ne9chv7"]here[/url]! [/h3][p][b]PRIZE:[/b] 1x Steam key for [i]either[/i] [b]The Royal Writ[/b] [i]or[/i] [b]Dicealot[/b] (winner's choice!) [/p][p][b]DEADLINE:[/b] Thursday, 25 September 2025 16:00 BST  [/p][p][i][url="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eoonlX_MIWzQZP41RG5hF9RAXWMKFr5J/view?usp=sharing"]Terms & Conditions[/url] apply.[/i][/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Hidden Artwork and More Community Spotlights!
notes.content: [h3]Remember this painting from the main menu?[/h3][p][/p][p]Have you ever looked at it and wondered why it looks so familiar?[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcM_hbGT4y81wuBUn09PVvIL1S4zYGFMjL0G3kaXc8pDa37YU9FuZy9Vfhkxg5_XLZNGX7_21-xgVDFd1Xm7mtvBAi8ae1mx87Mkh99YNZ__-O6YP97Jtb4ryvbNneTy-_8npoH?key=tbMFIoTRJCUZ4Ez1ktEKhw"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Well, this painting is also based on a real one - George Washington's crossing of the Delaware River! This event occurred on the night of December 25th - 26th, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. It was the first move in a complex and surprise military manoeuvre organized by George Washington, the commander-in-chief of the Continental Army. Here's the existing painting  below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/23b479455463c20d84719fc758d956c6fc097b71.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There are so many IRL inspirations in this game! We've mentioned some of them in previous From the Court editions, but do you think you can spot any more?[/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: New Public Beta & help us with Community Translations!
notes.content:
[h3]Want to be among the first to try out new features for The Royal Writ? [/h3][p]We've added a new public beta branch! To access it, right click the game on Steam, go to Properties > Betas, and select "public_experimental" from the dropdown menu. [/p][p][/p][p]As this is an experimental branch, new features may not be localised into languages other than English, and you may encounter bugs. As always, any ⁠feedback and bug reports are super appreciated - please just make sure to mention that your feedback is about the beta rather than the current main version. You can even join the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] to drop your feedback and bug reports![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Localisation Feedback [/h3][p]Is there something in the main game that doesn't feel like it's worded quite right? You can now submit suggestions for better translations directly through our [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SyN_E8oyxcLfNGYePHBwnZ7Pt87ZHCRdCyr5S1dgY70/edit?usp=sharing"]localisation sheet[/url]![/p][p][/p][h3]
Here are the updates coming to the beta: [/h3][p][/p][p][b]Version 1.0.1.0e[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a hand size indicator[/p][/*][*][p]Consumable, letter and spy cards no longer count towards the hand size (highly experimental)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new mushroom [b]Silk Shank[/b] that cures one ailment of a card[/p][/*][*][p]Added new letter [b]Paper infantry[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added a [i]Royal Copier[/i] event to before the final boss of Act II[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Repka, Tilemaker[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Can be promoted any number of times[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Vaida, Mizanthrope[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Shot: Steals 1 base power from all cards in combat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Feher, Escaped Patient[/b][/p][list][*][p]Inflicted with any ailment:[/p][p]+2 base power[/p][/*][*][p]If it has over 4 ailments:[/p][p]Cure all its ailments[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]The Lady of Misfortune[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]All other cards in its lane gain 1 base power, fall back to hand and are inflicted with [i]Spooked[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kelemen, Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]+2 base power per character card in hand[/p][/*][*][p]Kill a card in hand[/p][p]-1 base power per card in combat[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kesi, (Still) Annoying[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Double the base power it steals[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Kan, Short-Tempered General[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Also give the knocked-out card 5 base power[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Bombardier Sorbus[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Multiply the projectile’s base power by -1 instead of triggering the projectile[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changed ability of [b]Doctor Baltazar[/b][/p][list][*][p]When played:[/p][p]The brief power of bleeding cards is converted to base power”[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Ludum Dare to Today and the Ant Army!
notes.content: [h3]Greetings, loyal subjects![/h3][h3][/h3][p]Welcome back to the court, we always love having you here every week![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Have you seen what the game looked like back in Ludum Dare?[/h3][p][/p][p]Ludum Dare is an online event where developers are challenge to create a game from scratch in a weekend! They've been around since 2002 and run every April and October with a specific theme. The Royal Writ was created as a part of Ludum Dare 55, how cool is that? And now here we are with a game that is being fully fledged right before our eyes. Here's some before and after screenshots of what the game looked like back then compared to where it is now - [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/319b9bf2a5ed579fc5253ff9b34a12a03ce64cfd.png"][/img][i]The City Before[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a08738b9c3ced92a43a2d77b9d4dfb410818d80.jpg"][/img][i]The City Now[/i][/p][p][/p][p]You can really see how much has changed from the early days, this was back in early 2024![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f4a739b4881812e05e7d956321ba934017544bb3.png"][/img][i]Shady Bargain Before[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/9ba8aa50f76f420a89bb5a0dda00b7cc3d2e77a1.jpg"][/img][i]Shady Bargain Now[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I don't think I can fangirl over the art style enough, it's so darn cute I need like 5 tattoos.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]One of our producers has achieved peak Ant.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/953de24723836fbe7013664e44be3ce0e870d061.png"][/img][/p][p]These darn ants... pretty signific-ant if you ask me. There are definitely ants in Simon's pants about this. You can't be ignor-ant about the ant army... okay okay I'll stop.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Nottingham Video Games Expo - Thanks for coming by![/h3][p][/p][p]It was so much fun to meet you guys and watch your strategies, even some of you beating the demos! (So I've been told, I wasn't there. Sounded fun though, I'm not jealous or anything.) [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/f19e7a6648b33c2a14f7a8ac214f2d7d07c28982.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for playing the game and for all your kind words! We're less than a week away from launch and really hope you're just as excited as we are![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This is me after this long week. And probably for the forseeable future as I have given my life away to The Royal Writ. It has consumed me. It's too addictive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/349bdd4e002c3553a93f7fb448f34a64b6a6c08f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Release Date Hath Been Revealed!
notes.content:
[h2]Hear ye, hear ye! [/h2][p]
The moment ye have all been awaiting has arrived! Following our grand reveal at the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkAY-R_v4sY"]Secret Sauce Showcase[/url], we are thrilled to announce that [b]The Royal Writ[/b] shall be released upon the realm to all you eager and loyal subjects on [b]August 7th[/b]!  [/p][p][/p][p]Mark thy calendars, for on this auspicious date, all strategists may finally command their full army of warriors in the complete campaign of sacrifice and glory! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkAY-R_v4sY"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🎬 New Trailer![/h3][p]Our court scribes have prepared moving images to commemorate this momentous occasion! Witness the splendour that awaits thee in our official release date trailer - [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/R107fWXePy8?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]The time draws near when permanent consequences and strategic sacrifice shall be yours to command in full![/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to wishlist The Royal Writ and join the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] legion to stay up to date with all things The Royal Writ. Fear not - our demo shall tide thee over until the glorious day![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710820/The_Royal_Writ_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][i]P.S., did you hear Ludwig call our game very wishlistable? He's not wrong. It is. It's addictive. Sometimes I play it for so long I forget I'm actually meant to be working.[/i][/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Losing Time, Lego Inspirations and Community Art!
notes.content: [h2]Welcome back to another royal decree From the Court![/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]⏰Have you ever caught yourself playing The Royal Writ so much that you've almost missed something important?[/h3][p][/p][p]Well, our MD, Simon sure did. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/fe20e7f71e787f27697c40721727f91c869b6fae.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p]What's the longest you've played in one sitting? I feel like we should probably throw a warning label on the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🐑 If you're a hardcore LEGO fan, you may have noticed something...[/h3][p][/p][p]Have you ever wondered why some of the characters look a little bit familiar?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe_Kj5wZCsMmv4cBRga7mirLq5DQHU_3e3PRc866vBo2BMsuNVlzardZ-6vQF-hNDP1iPMJMylNb1gdSrs67R3qUZQExWDKvxsZr3J7usa8IMu6x1HkF4uLTG3SpFsDgGT9t4VPXA?key=tbMFIoTRJCUZ4Ez1ktEKhw"][/img][/p][p]Straight from the dev, Kornél: [i]As I’m an avid collector of old LEGO sets, it's no wonder that a lot of times I’m inspired by their whimsical world. I’m especially a big fan of Fabuland, which I think found a perfect balance with their characters’ proportions and general cuteness, so from that point on they were the blueprint and some of the earliest characters are very much directly based on them.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Fabuland was introduced in 1979, btw. That's so much older than I am.[/p][p][/p][p]Here's another set that Kornél shared with us, you might notice the Robert Horka inspiration![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/b8c7fdb568a929eadb503632425cce5d7d985c07.jpg"][/img][i]This is the Camouflaged Outpost from way back in 1987![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And a personal favourite from Kornél, the Fabulands fellas on their steamboat from 1985.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/418ea781125956f0961e6bb33c382c794c215dfb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Inspiration can really come from anywhere![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🔎 Community Spotlight: Our King by BubbleWizardOG[/h3][p][/p][p]One of our community members has graciously immortalised the King in a royal portrait! Thank you for this super cool drawing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/386192794cde69b14a7325a02db30696c059ea0b.png"][/img][i][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wladternovik/photo/7523566270705388822?lang=en-GB"]@wladternovik[/url][/i] [i]on TikTok[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you have anything cool to share with us, don't forget to join the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] and do so, we love seeing your stuff![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time 🫡[/p]

notes.title: From the Court: Huge Numbers, 4 Legged Creatures and Snakes Breaking Reality
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, royal subjects,[/h2][p][/p][p]This week we're sharing some fun little tidbits from the world of The Royal Writ![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🔢 Community member Balthromaw has been hitting some absolutely wild numbers[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/8fcc8a5ff39712b049cb9130be51f6f71cb19be0.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for sharing the pics with us, Balthromaw, just a matter of fixing the exploit now hah![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🖼️ You might have noticed this intriguing little easter egg painting while playing the demo[/b]...[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/eae010ac311b33687a64c000c2e3039ec67db07a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Deep lore...? What's the deal with four-legged animals among our anthropomorphic ones?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Here's some fun trivia: this artwork is inspired by a section of "Arrival of the Hungarians" - a circular panorama created by Hungarian painter Árpád Feszty between 1892 and 1894. The original masterpiece stands around 15m (50 ft) tall and stretches 120m (400 ft) long, featuring roughly 2000 people![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/fca829b5e40c066b804fac83cdc606ce92c2b70f.png"][/img][i](The segment that inspired the painting)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Our version is... considerably simpler :') Check it out in the [b]Options[/b] menu when you try the demo![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🐍 Last but not least, here's a gem from development - one small oversight that spawned an infinite loop[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/916d9fc89035058a42c18e12523c45073333164b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Borbak's ability is that you get a letter card if it enters a hazard[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4f752115919831163592cf00a295c6d6b686cf9d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There's a relic that removes the starting letters from your letter pool, and instead adds a letter card which floods the battlefield with hazards[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/5e7deda004f1a6e559bef0cea3ad94b13aa27fdf.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]This way you create an infinite loop of.. well... what you see in the gif above :')[/p][p][/p][p]If you've got anything fun to show us, do drop it in the Steam Forums or in the [url="https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh"]Discord[/url] and we might share it in the next From the Court![/p]

notes.title: The Royal Writ Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3]Attention, citizens of the realm! [/h3][p][/p][p]We're absolutely overjoyed to announce that [b]The Royal Writ[/b] will be a part of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest"]Steam Next Fest[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]For this special occasion, we've prepared an updated demo featuring some QoL improvements based on your valuable feedback. We would be most honoured for you to give the updated [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710820/The_Royal_Writ_Demo/"]demo[/url] a try, and maybe even [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333700/The_Royal_Writ/"]wishlist[/url] the game if you enjoy it![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/ecfb07411a1099def98dfdd913202c1a05056669.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710820/The_Royal_Writ_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]The Tails of Cross-Kingdom Friendship![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]In the finest tradition of indie collaboration, we've formed a wonderful partnership with the creators of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509430/Replicat/"]Replicat[/url] - a roguelike memory deck-builder featuring personality-packed cats and wild card combos![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate this alliance, we've exchanged some pieces of our kingdoms:[/p][list][*][p]⚔️ [b]In The Royal Writ Demo:[/b] Keep your eyes open for some familiar felines! notes.title: Hear Ye, Hear Ye! Royal Proclamation!
notes.content:
[h3]Good citizens of the online realm, [/h3]

It is with great honour and excitement that we announce that we have officially joined monarchies with [b]Yogscast Games![/b]

By royal decree, this roguelike deckbuilder of strategic sacrifice and battlefield glory shall henceforth be available for thy wishlist and perusal. The Kingdom of [b]Save Sloth Studios[/b], in partnership with the esteemed nobles of Yogscast Games, doth invite all strategists, tacticians, and lovers of peculiar animal warriors to gaze upon our creation.

And thus, add The Royal Writ to thy wishlist at once, for those who pledge their fealty early shall receive royal updates as development continues! And, by royal summons, we invite thee to our [url=https://discord.gg/qQumWvK6hh]Discord[/url]  chambers!

The kingdom has prepared a magical moving scroll for our beloved subjects, feast your eyes!

[previewyoutube=BOCcGL8FbNc;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]May thy sacrifices be worthwhile and thy victories sweet![/i]
